ask.title: Check for updates?
ask.help: The app can ask GitHub (api.github.com) whether a newer version exists. It sends the app's version and nothing about you or your music. It never downloads or installs anything. You can change this in Settings.

settings.label: Update checks
settings.help: Off until you turn it on. When on, the app asks GitHub (api.github.com) about once a day whether a newer version exists. It sends the app's version and nothing else. It only tells you; you install it yourself.
settings.upToDate: You have the latest version. Last checked {{when}}
settings.newer: A newer version is available. See About

about.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the address and copy it.
